svg.title: Caravel architecture
svg.desc: Tauri 2 desktop app: the Svelte UI calls Tauri commands into the Rust task core; AgentDriver runs coding agents over ACP, Codex App Server and CLI/JSONL, and RunSink stores normalized AgentEvents in SQLite and pushes them to the UI.
svg.text: spawn process · JSON-RPC over stdio · AgentDriver
three transports, one stream · SQLite + UI events

g.text: take task FIFO lock · write run record
prepare workspace: source dir or isolated worktree
RunSink stores to SQLite · emits live UI events
session/close · process exits, next turn resumes by session id
App Server: thread/start → turn/start, turn/steer to add input
per-request usage · rollout dedupe by time window
Feishu card callback → bridge → task action
LAN web client → axum → continue chat
Pi native JSONL driver · same AgentEvent stream
CLI messages / thinking / tools / plans → RunSink
Database tools / Mini Apps via commands
